title: Maharashtra disburses loan waiver to 6.2 lakh farmers
summary: Maharashtra began direct cash transfers under the Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Shetkari Karj-Mafi Yojana on 7 August 2026. The first phase covered more than 6.2 lakh eligible farmer accounts, and the scheme was framed as a farm loan waiver ...

blocks.content: Maharashtra began direct cash transfers under the Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Shetkari Karj-Mafi Yojana on 7 August 2026. The first phase covered more than 6.2 lakh eligible farmer accounts, and the scheme was framed as a farm loan waiver programme for short-term crop loans.

items: The Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Shetkari Karj-Mafi Yojana is Maharashtra’s farm loan waiver scheme.
Short-term crop loans up to ₹2 lakh are covered under the scheme.
The eligible loan period is from 1 April 2019 to 31 March 2025.
Aadhaar authentication is used in the verification process for beneficiary accounts.
